thesis: The site is the engagement ledger: each scroll reveals the next Thursday session as a physical slip with its inputs, outputs and homework.

signature.name: session-ledger
signature.summary: Ruled session slip with Thursday N of 6 heading, You bring / You leave with margin columns, dashed homework tear-off, and a continuous left gutter line that aligns across all slips.

motion.intro: Radial lamp glow fades in 0.8s on hero photo, then h1 line-mask reveals.
stories: Session counter advances and gutter line draws down as each slip enters view.
Six homework slips slide into stacked plan TOC in final section.
motion.hover: Hairline underline grows from left via scaleX, 200ms, pointer only.
